full_prompt_en: A square sepia-toned photographic artwork shows a woman seated low on a dark patterned floor, her head bowed towards her bent knees. She occupies the centre-left in right-facing profile, with dark hair gathered into a small bun behind her head. A pale cheek, ear and narrow neck emerge from the darker outline. She wears a long dark robe with a light collar edge and soft vertical folds. Her back slopes forward, while a clearly bent knee rises on the right side of her body. A pale hand rests near the top of this knee, giving the compact pose a quiet, inward focus. The lower robe gathers close to the floor, where its outline becomes less distinct. An irregular band of bright, fine ripple-like marks and scratchy translucent streaks crosses the base of the figure and spreads towards the lower right. Dark reflection-like shapes lie beneath the bright traces, overlapping the small repeated rectangular pattern of the floor. Some thin vertical scratches extend upwards through the figure and background, creating the impression of a worn print or layered exposure. The warm grey-beige wall occupies most of the upper image, separated from the darker floor by a low straight horizontal line. Its surface is largely empty, with subtle tonal variation and faint scuffs. Soft light reveals the bowed face and the upper folds without making the dark garment flat black. Brown-black shadows, olive-grey midtones and muted cream highlights keep the palette nearly monochromatic but distinctly warm. The compact seated silhouette and visible bent knee remain readable above the more ambiguous glowing lower textures. Broad empty space around the upper body balances the dense floor pattern and drifting traces, creating a still, introspective scene with a surreal photographic finish.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形棕褐调摄影艺术画面，一位女子低低坐在深色纹样地面上，朝弯曲膝部垂下头。她位于中心偏左，以侧面朝右，深色头发在脑后收成小发髻，较浅脸颊、耳朵与细颈从暗色外轮廓中显出。身上是带浅色领边的深色长袍，布料留有柔和竖褶。背部向前倾斜，身体右侧一只明确弯曲的膝盖隆起，一只浅色手停在膝部上方，使紧凑姿态显得安静内敛。下部袍料聚近地面，边缘在那里逐渐变得模糊。一道不规则、明亮细密的涟漪状痕迹与刮擦般半透明细线横过人物底部，向右下方铺散。深色倒影般的形状留在亮痕之下，与地面重复小矩形纹样交叠。部分纤细竖向划痕穿过人物和背景向上延伸，形成旧照片或叠加曝光般效果。暖灰米色墙面占据上半部大部分空间，与深色地面之间由一条较低直横线分开。墙面大多留空，只有细微色调起伏与浅擦痕。柔光显出低垂面部和上层衣褶，深色衣物仍保留层次，并非平黑。棕黑阴影、橄榄灰中间调与含蓄奶油色亮部，使画面接近单色，却明确带有暖意。紧凑坐姿剪影与弯膝在较暧昧的发亮下部纹理上方仍可辨认。上身周围的大块空处平衡密集地纹和漂移细痕，形成静止内省、带有超现实摄影质感的画面。
style_prompt_en: The style combines warm near-monochromatic photographic tones with a distressed, layered-print surface. Brown-black, olive-grey and muted cream preserve soft modelling within a restrained palette. Compact dark forms remain clear at their upper edges, then merge into translucent bright ripples, fine scratches and darker reflection-like patches. A small repeated geometric texture anchors the lower plane, while broad quiet fields keep the rest of the composition open. Diffuse light reveals subtle tonal changes without sharp cast shadows. Asymmetrical framing and the contrast between solid contours and dissolving marks create a still, introspective and faintly surreal effect.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格结合暖调近单色摄影色阶与磨损、叠印般表面。棕黑、橄榄灰和含蓄奶油色在克制色谱内保留柔和塑形。紧凑暗形的上缘清楚，下部逐渐融入半透明亮涟漪、细划痕及倒影般深色块。小型重复几何纹理稳住下方平面，宽阔安静色域则使其余构图保持开放。漫射光揭示细微色阶，没有锐利投影。不对称框取，以及实体轮廓与消散痕迹的反差，形成静止内省、略带超现实的效果。
theme_en: A bowed woman seated low above a luminous ripple-like trace
theme_zh: 低头静坐的女子与脚边发亮涟漪状痕迹
name: Kansuke Yamamoto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
